results.name: Navigation, History (Back/Forward), and Refresh
results.message: Successfully verified navigation link, back/forward history, and page refresh.
results.expected: Seamless page transition, history navigation, and persistence on refresh

results.name: Text Input (Entry, Value Verification, and Clear)
results.message: Text entered, verified via DOM property, and successfully cleared.

results.name: Button Interaction & Cryptographic Token Generation
results.message: Button click triggered key generation successfully: G3LT-HSVQ
results.expected: Button updates state label and generates dynamic token matching XXXX-XXXX format
results.actual: Button feedback confirmed; new token 'G3LT-HSVQ' verified against regex pattern
results.description: Click cryptographic generator button, verify state change and token pattern.

results.name: Required-Field Form Validation
results.message: Submission verified; blank credentials rejected and retained on /login/.
results.expected: Form halts submission on blank input; user retained on /login/
results.actual: Retained on http://127.0.0.1:8000/login/; error state confirmed.
results.description: Submit empty login form, verify client-side validation blocks submission.

results.name: Invalid Authentication Handling
results.message:
Negative auth triggered expected error alert: 'error
Invalid username or password. Please try again.'
results.expected: Error alert displayed containing 'Invalid username or password'
results.actual:
Error alert visible with text: 'error
Invalid username or password. Please try again.'
results.description: Submit nonexistent credentials, verify error alert display with proper message.

results.name: Sandbox Document Selector & Dynamic Recalculation
results.message: Selection updated from '2 selected (3.5 MB)' to '1 selected (2.4 MB)'
results.expected: Dynamic recalculation of count and cumulative file size upon checkbox toggle
results.description: Toggle document checkboxes, verify real-time recalculation of count & MBs.

results.name: Cryptographic Expiration Timer Selection
results.message: Expiration timer switched successfully to '15 mins'
results.expected: Telemetry card reflects selected duration ('15 mins')
results.actual: Telemetry label successfully synced to '15 mins'
results.description: Click expiration pills, verify countdown telemetry label synchronizes.
